purpose: Short runner smoke validation; not the repeated experiment matrix

definitions.windows: Traffic runs baseline+observation+2 guard seconds. Fault command is scheduled after the leading guard and baseline; actual command start anchors exactly15s baseline+60s observation (smoke uses1s+3s). Controls use the same scheduled anchor. Guard requests remain in raw evidence and are counted separately.
definitions.wholeSuccessRate: Complete2xx requests / all actually launched requests within [anchor-baseline,anchor+observation). Whole includes baseline and postfault traffic.
definitions.postFaultSuccessRate: Complete2xx requests / all actually launched requests within [actual fault command start,command start+observation). Inflight pre-fault launches are excluded; command duration is recorded. Controls have null postFault and separate observation metrics.
definitions.skipped: Scheduled slots skipped by generator for scheduler lag or concurrency limit. Excluded from request success denominators and explicitly counted by scheduled time; skipped slots in the analysis window invalidate that trial. Guard drops remain visible.
definitions.latency: Request launch to full body or terminal error; nearest-rank p50/p95. latencyMs includes HTTP failures/timeouts; successfulLatencyMs includes only complete2xx.
definitions.detectionMs: First failure_confirmed event after fault command start, on calibrated controller Linux monotonic clock, minus host fault-command start. Requires3 consecutive failed probes.
definitions.recoveryMs: First recovery_verified event after fault command start minus that start, using calibrated monotonic clocks. Requires2 readiness successes with stable revalidated container identity; never Docker restart acceptance alone. Null means not observed within the60s window (or not applicable for controls).
definitions.firstSiblingSuccessMs: First actual successful request launched to backend-b after fault start. Traffic failover observation, separate from restoration of backend-a.
definitions.longestFailureIntervalMs: Time from first failed request launch in each consecutive failure sequence to next successful request launch, censored at window end; maximum across sequences. Sampling metric, not proof of continuous outage.
definitions.clock: 3 timed Dockerexec samples before/after each trial; select minimumroundtrip midpoint mapping hosthrtime to VMhrtime. Halfroundtrip is mapping uncertainty; reject drift above summed uncertainties+100ms.
definitions.trialValidity: Fresh resources; healthy initial readiness and balanced baseline for two backends; intended fault verified; no skipped slots in measured window; valid clock mapping; sibling healthy; disabled configurations do not restart; C readinessverified recovery observed. HTTP errors are measured, not grounds for discarding a trial.

definitions.achievedRequestsPerSecond: requests launched / configured durationSeconds; wallDurationMs includes draining outstanding requests
definitions.latency: GET launch to complete body or terminal error; all includes HTTP errors and timeouts; success includes only complete 2xx responses; nearest-rank percentiles
definitions.dropped: schedule slots skipped for concurrency or scheduler lag; excluded from request and success counts
definitions.upstreamAddr: raw X-Upstream-Addr response header, or null when absent
definitions.upstreamStatus: raw X-Upstream-Status response header; preserves multiple Nginx attempts even when final response succeeds; null when absent

All containers share one host and Docker VM; host failures are not protected.
